ccdp_gradient.description: Premium brand gradient (blue → violet → magenta → orange)

rules.headings: Never use Inter for headings. Use Playfair Display for editorial moments and Cabinet Grotesk for functional UI headings. Keep line-height tight.
rules.tracking: Use tight tracking for large headings (-0.02em to -0.04em) and loose tracking for uppercase overlines (0.2em).

visual_enhancers.textures: Use extremely subtle noise overlays (opacity 2-3%) on pure black backgrounds to eliminate digital flatness and create a premium film-like feel.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism sticky header. bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/5.
navigation.layout: Logo centered or left. Links prominently displayed on desktop, hidden in premium full-screen menu on mobile.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-[#0A44FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0836CC] transition-all duration-300
buttons.gradient: Pill-shaped, background uses CCDP gradient, text-white. Use sparingly for special collections or AIAH concierge.
buttons.outline: Pill-shaped, transparent bg, border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-all
buttons.ghost: Hover text glow or subtle bg-white/5

product_cards.style: Minimalist luxury. Zero or 1px subtle border. No heavy drop shadows. Image area takes up 80% of the card.
product_cards.image_treatment: MUST use Placeholder media system. Gradient backgrounds replacing photos.
product_cards.text_layout: Title left, price right. OR everything centered. Use text-secondary for category.

aiah_concierge.style: Floating orb or sleek minimal sidebar. Uses CCDP gradient for AI 'thinking' states. Soft pulsing animations.
aiah_concierge.typography: Conversational UI uses Outfit. AI messages have subtle glass background.

inputs.style: Underline or pill-shaped. border-white/20, bg-transparent. Focus state: border-[#0A44FF] or bottom border glow.

media_system.description: Instead of real photography, use premium branded gradient placeholders for all product images and campaign banners to allow easy swapping later.
styles: bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-900 via-black to-gray-900 border border-white/5
media_system.iconography: Center a minimalist Lucide icon (e.g., Camera, Shirt, Monitor) with text-white/20 at 48px size inside the placeholder.

homepage.hero: Full viewport height (100vh) editorial placeholder banner. Massive typography overlapping the background. Parallax scroll.
homepage.featured: Bento box grid or horizontal smooth scroll (Lenis).
homepage.departments: Asymmetric masonry or alternating left/right heavy text + placeholder media blocks.

pdp_page.style: Split screen on desktop. Left side: sticky media gallery placeholder. Right side: scrolling product details, variants, typography.
pdp_page.buy_box: Fixed bottom bar on mobile, standard right column on desktop.

dashboard_admin.style: High density, technical but premium. Use Cabinet Grotesk. 1px borders. No glassmorphism here, use solid #121212 surfaces to prevent data refraction.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward translation (y: 20 -> 0) over 0.6s using Framer Motion.
motion.hover_states: Images scale up slightly (1.05) within hidden overflow containers. Buttons slight scale down (0.98) on click.
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis is mandatory for premium feel.
motion.aiah: Gradient rotation or gentle pulsing opacity for the AI concierge button.

libraries.icons: lucide-react (preferred for crisp minimalist lines) or @phosphor-icons/react
libraries.ui_primitives: shadcn/ui (radix-ui) heavily customized to remove default styles

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients meets WCAG AA 4.5:1. Use text-shadow if needed over complex placeholders.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible styling (ring-2 ring-[#0A44FF] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-black).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons (like the AIAH chat toggle).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use random stock photography or Unsplash images. You MUST build a modular placeholder media system using the CCDP gradients and near-black tones. The user explicitly requested 'brand placeholder treatments'.
CRITICAL: Background MUST be near-black (#050505), not generic gray. Avoid `#000000` to maintain depth, use `#050505`.
Use Playfair Display for massive, editorial campaign headings.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for sleek UI headings, department names, and product titles.
Use Outfit for clean, readable body copy and meta information.
Add `data-testid` to all actionable UI elements (buttons, links, cart triggers, AIAH toggles).
Avoid Shadcn defaults. E.g., make cards borderless or 1px `border-white/5` with `#111111` background.
Integrate the CCDP gradient (blue -> violet -> magenta -> orange) sparingly as an accent: text gradient on hero, border on the AIAH concierge, or hover state on premium cards.
Ensure the layout feels 'cinematic' - use full bleed sections, generous vertical spacing (py-24 or py-32), and large typography.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on the sticky navigation without a heavy blur and semi-solid background (e.g., bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl).
